topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: I can hardly believe what I'm hearing. They took your cart right from your own land, they did. What kind of sense does that make? The soil doesn’t move its own crops, and you can’t till the earth with bare hands. You need your tools, your yoke, your cart. How are you meant to tend to your needs, to your family’s needs, when they take what little you have? I say we ought to gather, speak to the bailiff, remind him of the labors we endure under the sun, the sacrifices we make to keep the land fertile. It’s bad enough with the debts and the tithe, but to lose your means of work? That’s a darkness no man should bear alone.
